_comment: Qubit mode: three candidate 2-level states as Bloch vectors [rx,ry,rz]. This is a GENUINE quantum-information calculation in closed form (trace distance = half the Bloch-vector distance; Uhlmann fidelity; Helstrom optimal single-shot probability; the optimal measurement axis = the Bloch direction of rho-sigma). |0>=(0,0,1) vs |1>=(0,0,-1) are orthogonal (trace distance 1, perfectly distinguishable); |0> vs |+>=(1,0,0) are the canonical partially-distinguishable pair (trace distance 1/sqrt2). Use this mode when a coherent representation genuinely exists (a real quantum experiment, or a mathematical object faithfully modeled as a 2-level system).
